title: The least prime factor of a number at least 2 is at least 2
statement: For every natural n with 2 <= n, 2 <= minFac n. minFac's linear candidate search starts at 2 and only ever increments, so the statement is an invariant of the fuel recursion.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.min_fac_two_le : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat.le (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) x0) -> AxNat.le (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) (AxNat.minFac x0)))

evidence.supports: Nat.min_fac_two_le is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- min_fac_two_le 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE '^Nat\.min_fac_two_le.2.\(\(x0 : AxNat\) -> \(\(x1 : AxNat\.le \(AxNat\.succ \(AxNat\.succ AxNat\.zero\)\) x0\) -> AxNat\.le \(AxNat\.succ \(AxNat\.succ AxNat\.zero\)\) \(AxNat\.minFac x0\)\)\)$')" = 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check. The pattern pins the ARITY and the FULL rendered type, not the theorem's presence: `scripts/new-fact.py` rejected a name-only pattern as population-only, because it catches the row disappearing but not the statement changing inside a row that is still there.

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the Nat environment admits no trusted declaration
evidence.notes: Reports `nat: axiom=0 opaque=0 quotient=0 total_trusted=0` over the FULL trusted surface (Axiom, Opaque and Quotient), not `Declaration::Axiom` alone, and exits non-zero unless the surface is empty. The enumeration is per-environment rather than per-theorem; it bounds this theorem's footprint because a proof cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain. Read directly from `Kernel::axiom_footprint` via `theorem_axiom_footprint`, this theorem's row prints footprint size 0 and an empty axiom column, and all 904 `nat` rows do. (Count the tool's OWN summary line, not `grep -c '^nat'` -- the summary starts with `nat:` too, so the naive count is 905.)

provenance.source: theorem name and canonical type read directly via nat_theorem_inventory, which prints render_lean of the admitted type; declared by `nat_prelude/min_fac_dvd.rs` (lane nat-factorization).

notes: The `2 <= n` hypothesis is not removable: `minFac 1 = 1` by this development's boundary convention (matching Mathlib's), so the unconditional statement is FALSE. It is about THIS `minFac`, a fuel-recursive linear search, not about Mathlib's well-founded one -- see `nat_prelude/min_fac.rs`'s module doc for why the two compute the same values without being the same `def`, and why no `ml430` mirror is flipped by it.
